“the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”

“the federal goverment” >>> “the federal government”

“matters more then ever” >>> “matters more than ever”

“has three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> [CHECK: Three cosponsors are claimed, but only two are named.]

“it's definitions are broad” >>> “its definitions are broad”

“its central principal” >>> “its central principle”

“the bill's enforcment regime” >>> “the bill's enforcement regime”

“would directly effect every company” >>> “would directly affect every company”

“Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> [CHECK: Whitfield is identified as R-OH earlier and R-OK here.]

“narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “narrows the registry in Section 4”

“keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty in Section 5” >>> [CHECK: The earlier summary specifies $1 million per day. Confirm the amount and whether the amendment changes or keeps it.]

“who's support may depend on it” >>> “whose support may depend on it”

“the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”

“of the committees 28 members” >>> “of the committee's 28 members”

“28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> [CHECK: The vote categories total 29, not 28.]

“The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> [CHECK: Five senators are listed, but the preceding sentence says six are undecided. Also reconcile the list with the later descriptions of Kowalski and Ames.]

“Thursday, October 14” >>> “Thursday, October 15”

“after the September 23 hearing” >>> [CHECK: The timeline dates the committee hearing September 30. Confirm whether these are separate hearings or one date is incorrect.]

“in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”

“The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”

“Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”

“as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”

“occured on September 30” >>> “occurred on September 30”

“the treaty negotiations required by Section 6 would have to conclude within two years” >>> [CHECK: The earlier Section 6 summary specifies negotiating an international agreement within 18 months, not two years.]

“a close compliment to S. 2817” >>> “a close complement to S. 2817”

“with the the offices” >>> “with the offices”

“call there senators” >>> “call their senators”

“you should recieve” >>> “you should receive”

“Each of our five regional policy leads” >>> [CHECK: The opening sentence of this section says there are six regional policy leads.]
